scripts.generate: pnpm --dir spacetimedb install && cargo run -p gen-bindings -- --out-dir src/module_bindings --module-path spacetimedb && prettier --write src/module_bindings

@remix-run/react: Introduces React Router. GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6 and GHSA-jjmj-jmhj-qwj2 allow crafted link/redirect destinations to escape the origin or execute script.
This template has no Link/useNavigate calls or redirects fed by user-supplied destinations.
GHSA-337j-9hxr-rhxg can invoke unintended browser constructors when SSR error properties are attacker-controlled.
Our loader catches fetch errors and returns an empty list; it never copies request data into serialized error properties.
@remix-run/node: Introduces turbo-stream 2. GHSA-rxv8-25v2-qmq8 allows crafted loader data to exhaust CPU during single-fetch serialization.
vite.config.ts keeps v3_singleFetch false, so this template does not use that vulnerable transport.

@remix-run/dev: toml GHSA-v5mp-jgw5-2x6j and estree-util-value-to-estree GHSA-f7f6-9jq7-3rqj require crafted frontmatter to cause prototype pollution.
Frontmatter is compiled from repository files, not visitor requests. This excludes a visitor-triggered path, not malicious build inputs.
